name: Dean & Deluca Cafe Marunouchi
description: A polished deli-cafe steps from Tokyo Station where counter seats offer outlets and free Wi-Fi for a quick focused stint.

name: Cafe Lexcel Tokyo International Forum
description: A calm basement cafe inside the International Forum with fast building Wi-Fi and outlets along the counter and terrace.

name: Tully's Coffee & TEA KITTE Marunouchi
description: A spacious Tully's in the KITTE building offering free Wi-Fi plus outlets at counter and some table seats a couple minutes from Tokyo Station.

name: Kaiteki Cafe
description: A weekday business-district cafe directly linked to Otemachi Station with free Wi-Fi and powered counter seating.

name: Doutor Coffee Kanda Kita-guchi
description: A large 81-seat Doutor right by Kanda Station's north exit with Wi-Fi and scattered outlets for early-morning work.

name: Excelsior Cafe Kanda Kita-guchi
description: A roomy 100-seat Excelsior near Kanda's north exit providing Wi-Fi and outlets for laptop sessions.

name: Blossom & Bouquet Akihabara UDX
description: An 83-seat cafe in the Akihabara UDX complex with free Wi-Fi and outlets, geared toward weekday workers.

name: Renoir Akihabara Denki-gai-guchi
description: A traditional-style Renoir a minute from the Electric Town exit offering free Wi-Fi, outlets and roomy seating for long stays.

name: Flying Scotsman Akihabara
description: A work-oriented Akihabara cafe with fiber Wi-Fi and an outlet at every seat, well suited to extended laptop work.

name: Tully's Coffee Jimbocho
description: A roughly 50-seat Tully's near Jimbocho Station with free Wi-Fi and outlets, handy for morning or meeting work.

name: Doutor Coffee Jimbocho Ekimae
description: A Doutor directly at Jimbocho's A5 exit with partitioned powered counter seats, though a peak-hour time limit applies.

name: Sakura Cafe Jimbocho
description: A hotel-attached, internationally minded cafe open around the clock with free Wi-Fi and outlets for any-hour work.

name: Onca Coffee
description: A no-time-limit independent coffee shop with free Wi-Fi and outlets along its long bench seat between Jimbocho and Otemachi.

name: Think Coffee Jimbocho
description: A two-floor specialty cafe with fast free Wi-Fi and outlets on some upstairs seats and no seating time limit.

name: Brooklyn Roasting Company Tokyo International Forum
description: A compact roastery cafe in the International Forum with fast free Wi-Fi and some powered tables, subject to a 2-hour limit when busy.

name: Streamer Coffee Company Nakameguro
description: A glass-walled specialty coffee shop known for latte art where window counter seats offer outlets and a calm weekday atmosphere for laptop work.

name: FRAMES Nakameguro
description: A large roughly 100-seat cafe-bar a short walk from the station with free Wi-Fi and outlets at select seats, better suited to those who can focus amid a lively crowd.

name: Open Nakameguro
description: A bright white-toned open space that doubles as a rental venue, offering free Wi-Fi and window-counter outlets for relaxed daytime work.

name: Podium Cafe
description: A resort-styled cafe attached to an automotive showroom concept where free Wi-Fi and outlets support a quiet escape from the surrounding bustle.

name: Starbucks Coffee Nakameguro GT Tower
description: A basement-level Starbucks near the station with free Wi-Fi and outlets along the window counter and central table, giving a comparatively calm chain option.

name: Starbucks Coffee Nakameguro Tsutaya Bookstore
description: A bookstore-integrated Starbucks with around 15 outlets along its counter, pleasant for reading-and-working sessions though it fills up quickly.

name: Freshness Burger Nakameguro Ekimae
description: A bright casual burger chain right by the station whose counter has roughly six outlet-equipped seats, making it a budget spot for quick laptop work.

name: Roju Cafe
description: A renovated-warehouse cafe furnished with designer and mid-century pieces, offering free Wi-Fi and counter outlets in a stylish space that also serves as a rental studio.

name: Good Sound Coffee Nakameguro
description: A high-ceilinged 60-seat cafe built around a multi-speaker sound concept, with free Wi-Fi and outlets at both bench and counter seating for long work sessions.

name: Alpha Beta Coffee Club Jiyugaoka
description: A spacious West-Coast-styled specialty coffee club by the station praised for fast reliable Wi-Fi and floor-level outlets at the center tables, well suited to extended work.

name: Onibus Coffee Jiyugaoka
description: A light-filled, wood-toned specialty roaster branch with its own Wi-Fi and around ten dual outlets beneath the central bench, making it comfortable for telework.

name: Latte Graphic Jiyugaoka
description: An Australian-inspired 65-seat cafe open from early morning with free Wi-Fi and outlets at table seating, giving flexible space for solo work.

name: Doutor Coffee Jiyugaoka Marie-Claire Street
description: A tidy white-interior Doutor with free Wi-Fi and outlets at roughly twenty seats, a cheap and convenient option though a 90-minute stay limit is noted.

name: Coffee Base Meguro
description: A modern specialty coffee shop with terrace seating on the Meguro-ku side of the station, offering free Wi-Fi and outlets for focused daytime work.

name: Cafe Veloce Meguro
description: A two-floor budget chain cafe on the Meguro-ku west side of the station with free Wi-Fi, outlets, and ample single-seat availability.

name: Bunkitsu Roppongi
description: A paid-entry bookshop-cafe with no time limit, bottomless coffee, Wi-Fi in the reading room and outlets at counter seating, a calm all-day spot to work among 30,000 books.

name: Verve Coffee Roasters Roppongi
description: A bright, glass-fronted specialty roaster with English-speaking staff, no time limit and free Wi-Fi, though power outlets are limited and mostly on the first floor.

name: Common Roppongi
description: A spacious cafe-by-day, bar-by-night close to Roppongi Station with a warm, quiet atmosphere, free Wi-Fi and outlets at some seats.

name: Renoir Roppongi Lapiros
description: A traditional full-service coffee lounge where all of its roughly 97 seats have outlets, a reliable if pricier choice for long focused sessions.

name: PARK6
description: A cafe inside Roppongi Hills Mori Tower reported to have outlets at all of its 92 seats plus Wi-Fi, well suited to laptop work.

name: Starbucks Roppongi Hills West Walk
description: A busy Roppongi Hills Starbucks with free Wi-Fi and a limited number of outlets at counter seating.

name: Streamer Coffee Company Azabu-Juban
description: A latte-art-focused specialty cafe with a concrete-and-wood interior and bilingual-friendly vibe, reported to offer both Wi-Fi and power outlets for working visitors.

name: Starbucks Azabu-Juban
description: A multi-floor Starbucks near Azabu-Juban Station with free Wi-Fi and a cluster of outlets around a third-floor center table.

name: Ueshima Coffee Ten Azabu-Juban
description: A relaxed, wood-toned coffee chain branch open long hours with registration-based Wi-Fi and outlets at part of the seating.

name: The Core Kitchen/Space
description: A large, open cafe-and-dining space along Shintora-dori with Wi-Fi and outlets at wall-side seats, comfortable for extended work.

name: Logi Cafe
description: A small basement cafe near Uchisaiwaicho where every one of its roughly 20 seats has an outlet plus Wi-Fi, tailored to solo work.

name: Excelsior Caffe Shimbashi 2-chome
description: An affordable two-floor coffee-chain branch a couple minutes from Shimbashi Station with free Wi-Fi and outlets at several spots.

name: Renoir Shimbashi Shiodome-guchi Ekimae
description: A classic sit-and-stay coffee lounge right by the Shiodome exit offering free Wi-Fi and outlets at counter seats.

name: Accea Cafe Tamachi
description: A 24-hour pay-per-time work cafe near Tamachi with free Wi-Fi and outlets at every seat, built specifically for laptop work.

name: Starbucks Tamachi Tower
description: A Starbucks in the Tamachi Tower complex with free Wi-Fi and around a dozen outlets along the counter seating.

name: Ueshima Coffee Ten Aoyama
description: A calm coffee-chain branch on the Minato side of Omotesando with registration-based Wi-Fi and outlets at counter seats.

name: Freeman Cafe
description: A reliably work-oriented cafe right by the station with fast free Wi-Fi and outlets at most of its many tables, though a two-hour limit applies when busy.

name: FabCafe Tokyo
description: A bright, creative-leaning cafe on Dogenzaka with fast free Wi-Fi, outlets around its roughly 58 seats, and even 3D-printer and laser-cutter services for makers.

name: Forest Library
description: A book-lined library-cafe hybrid a minute from the station with free Wi-Fi, outlets and unlimited drinks, though it charges an hourly seat rate rather than a simple drink minimum.

name: Komeda Coffee Shibuya Miyamasuzaka
description: A spacious neighborhood-living-room style chain cafe with partitioned comfy seating, free Wi-Fi and outlets at nearly every seat, with a 90-minute limit during crowded periods.

name: Streamer Coffee Company Shibuya
description: A stylish latte-art specialist with a big communal worktable, counter seating and around ten plugs plus free Wi-Fi, though loud music makes it better with headphones for focused work.

name: Udagawa Cafe
businessHours: Late; open into early morning (sources vary)
description: A vintage-furnished cafe with free Wi-Fi and outlets across its roughly 80 seats that stays open very late, making it a rare option for night-owl working sessions.

name: MOJA in the House
description: A large 120-plus-seat cafe known for chicken and waffles, offering free Wi-Fi and outlets at counter and sofa areas, though lunchtime crowds can fill it up.

name: The Theatre Table
description: A roomy restaurant-cafe high up in Shibuya Hikarie with free Wi-Fi and outlets conveniently placed at table and sofa seating, good for a quieter mid-afternoon work stint.

name: Valley Park Stand
description: A bright Miyashita Park cafe with fast free Wi-Fi and outlets along a long shared table, best worked from in the quieter mornings before it gets busy; cashless only.

name: White Glass Coffee
description: A small specialty coffee shop on the Sakuragaoka side with free Wi-Fi and outlets, subject to a two-hour seating limit that keeps it turning over.

name: Kohi Chakan Premium Grand Shibuya
description: A classic-style coffee house with a European-pub feel offering free Wi-Fi and outlets, along with full meals if you want to settle in for a while.

name: Trunk Lounge
description: A design-hotel lobby lounge with very fast free Wi-Fi, outlets at working and lounge seats and no time limit, though it is pricey and dimly lit with little natural light.

name: Marked Cafe Shibuya Cast
description: A calm cafe in the Shibuya Cast complex with high-speed free Wi-Fi and outlets, well suited to daytime work but closing relatively early in the evening.

name: Starbucks Coffee Shibuya Modi
businessHours: Roughly matches Shibuya Modi building hours
description: One of the better Shibuya Starbucks branches for working, with free Wi-Fi and actual power outlets across its large floor, unlike many nearby Starbucks that have Wi-Fi but no outlets.

name: Dean & Deluca Cafe Shibuya Stream
description: A bakery-cafe connected to Shibuya Station in the Shibuya Stream complex with free Wi-Fi and power-equipped seating among its roughly 80 seats.

name: Tokyo Kenkyo
description: A pleasant rooftop-terrace cafe toward Daikanyama with free Wi-Fi but no power outlets, so it is best for reading or short sessions on a full battery.

name: Caffice
description: A purpose-built work cafe with a dedicated single-seat work zone where every seat has its own outlet and lamp, plus a lounge and standard cafe area.

name: Coffee Kizoku Edinburgh
description: A grand old-style kissaten open around the clock with a library-like hush, free Wi-Fi and outlets, making it a rare option for late-night work.

name: HAKADORU Shinjuku-sanchome
description: A no-membership drop-in coworking cafe charging by time with free drinks, outlets at every seat and booths where you can take video calls.

name: Brooklyn Parlor Shinjuku
description: A spacious Brooklyn-themed cafe-bar lined with books where free Wi-Fi is available but outlet seats are limited, and it can get busy in the afternoons.

name: The Smokist Coffee Shinjuku-gyoenmae
description: An all-smoking coffee stand aimed at working smokers, with free Wi-Fi and outlets at customer seats and early opening hours.

name: Coffee Seibu
description: A large retro kissaten open since the 1960s with 250-plus seats over multiple floors, free Wi-Fi and outlets concentrated at the upper-floor window seats.

name: Tully's Coffee Nishi-Shinjuku Ekimae
description: A convenient chain branch right by Nishi-Shinjuku station with open seating, free Wi-Fi and a number of outlet seats for casual work.

name: Starbucks Shinjuku Nishiguchi
description: A West-Exit Starbucks reachable via the underground passage that offers free Wi-Fi and outlets along its center and wall desks.

name: Starbucks Shinjuku Nomura Building
description: A basement office-building Starbucks connected underground to the station, with free Wi-Fi and outlets at its center and wall seating.

name: Cafe Hudson Shinjuku Mylord
description: A New York-styled cafe atop the station-connected Mylord building with free Wi-Fi, QR-code ordering and outlets in one designated seating section.

name: The 3rd Burger Shinjuku Ohgado
description: A health-oriented burger cafe with a large seat count that is popular for studying and working thanks to free Wi-Fi and available outlets.

name: Kissaten Renoir Shinjuku West Exit
description: A branch of the classic business-friendly Renoir kissaten chain with roomy seating, free Wi-Fi and outlets that welcomes long stays.

name: Komeda's Coffee Shinjuku-sanchome
description: A comfortable branch of the Komeda coffee chain with roomy booth seating, free Wi-Fi and outlets, though it often has a wait at peak times.

name: Paul Bassett Shinjuku
description: A premium champion-barista espresso cafe with free Wi-Fi but where sources disagree on outlets and at least one reports none, so it suits short high-quality coffee breaks more than long work.

name: Cotocafe
description: A cozy vintage-styled cafe with free Wi-Fi and a relaxed vibe, but sources conflict on whether outlets are available so power should not be relied upon.

name: Toki Cafe Kagurazaka
description: A budget-friendly Kagurazaka work cafe reported to have outlets at every seat, free Wi-Fi, a drink bar and even massage chairs.

name: Starbucks Kagurazaka-shita
description: A woody, calm two-floor Starbucks by Iidabashi station with free Wi-Fi and roughly 21 outlet-equipped spots across both levels.

name: Ueshima Coffee Ten Kagurazaka
description: A two-floor branch of the Ueshima coffee chain on Kagurazaka with 83 seats, free Wi-Fi and around ten outlet-equipped seats.
